settings.description: Provide your project's square footage, customize with add-ons, and add to cart. Only pay a $250 deposit at checkout to reserve your installation.

settings.question: How is pricing confirmed?
settings.answer:
The first step is providing details about your installation and paying for the non-refundable $250 Site Visit. 100% of this charge will be applied to your installation cost. It covers both your virtual consultation and the in-home visit for measurement.

A final quote will be provided after the assessment. You’ll get a call from our installation services team within one business day of making your reservation. Our team will discuss your installation needs and further refine your project.

The installer on site will keep you informed of any necessary services for a successful installation. Pricing is fully finalized at the completion of the installation.

faq_WP4VQY.name: What if my project has special conditions?

settings.question: What if my project has special conditions?
settings.answer: If there is anything special or unusual about your installation, be sure to mention it when discussing your online estimate with a member of our team. Many special circumstances or conditions may not be visible until the installation is underway. Our expert team will be able to address any concerns or questions over the phone consultation or on site.

settings.question: What happens after I checkout?
settings.answer:
Immediately after checkout, you’ll receive an email with a copy of the Installation Preparation Checklist, Terms & Conditions to review, and a copy of your paid reservation receipt.

Within 1 business day of checking out, you’ll receive a call from a member of our installation services team to discuss your project and schedule an in-home visit for measurement.

settings.question: What’s the warranty?
settings.answer: Separate from the individual product warranties, the Flooret Installation warranty covers 1 year, with the option to add on extended warranties up to 4 years.

faq_LaBFAH.name: How do I get a quote for Installation?

settings.question: How do I get a quote for Installation?
settings.answer:
Once you've paid $250 for a Site Visit, a member of our installation services team will give you a call within one business day to review your project and schedule an in-home measurement.

A formal quote will be provided after the assessment.

faq_cEbyAp.name: What do I do if I need help with my installation service after completion?

settings.question: What do I do if I need help with my installation service after completion?
settings.answer: Reach out to our installation service team at 1-800-700-8122 or email us at support@flooret.com.

faq_bXFnXH.name: Can I purchase Installation Services without Flooret flooring?

settings.question: Can I purchase Installation Services without Flooret flooring?
settings.answer: No, Flooret Installation is only available for Flooret Products.
